name: Halversen Thermal-Lined Work Vest
description: Sleeveless insulated vest in dark olive quilted nylon, worn as a mid-layer over a work shirt during the brutal Great Lakes winters. The chest is plain except for a small Halversen patch on the collar; the back has a single large internal pocket for a heat pack or comms tablet. Well-used versions are pilled and compressed at the shoulders from heavy jacket wear on top.
functionality: Core insulation layer for outdoor and unheated facility work; snap-front allows fast removal when moving between cold exterior and heated indoor zones.
what_it_says: You've learned the hard way that the lake wind doesn't care what shift you're on.
story_hooks: The internal back pocket is large enough to hold a folded-up document — a worker's vest contains a printed contract amendment their supervisor claimed was never distributed.
A vest left in a break room locker for six months still has a heat pack inside — activated, still faintly warm, with no explanation.
